title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过检索外部证据并将生成过程以检索到的上下文为条件，从而为大型语言模型（LLM）提供事实依据。尽管稠密检索在局部语义匹配方面较为有效，但独立排序的检索可能返回冗余段落、遗漏跨分块的依赖关系，并为多跳推理提供不完整的证据。我们提出了SpectRAG——一种谱图增强检索框架，它结合了混合候选种子选择、加权分块图构建、基于图的扩展、谱相关性传播以及基于Token预算的上下文选择。文档分块由稠密语义嵌入和图坐标系表示，后者源自一个加权分块图，其边编码了语义相似性、文档相邻性、章节层次结构、共享实体、引用链接以及LLM生成的效用问题之间的相似性。在查询时，SpectRAG构建一个hi……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: SpectRAG提出了一种谱图增强检索框架，通过构建编码多种语义与结构关系的加权分块图，结合谱相关性传播与Token预算约束下的上下文选择，解决传统独立检索在多跳推理中证据冗余和不完整的问题。
en_tdlr: SpectRAG is a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that constructs weighted chunk graphs encoding semantic and structural relations, and combines spectral relevance propagation with token-budgeted context selection to overcome redundant and incomplete evidence in multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation.
